title: Line sketch: Vibrant Masked Revelry
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A central stylized face with bold makeup is surrounded by floating ornate masks and abstract decorative shapes like stars and flowers. The asymmetric composition pops against a flat background using strong outlines and vibrant flat color fields. Technique emphasizes graphic illustration with clean shapes and retro flair (derived from painting #166).
